title: Motion score for spectral quality control of optoacoustic-ultrasound data
authors: Jan Kukačka; Maximilian Bader; Dominik Jüstel; Vasilis Ntziachristos

validated on ten scans including eight tissue-mimicking phantom scans and two in-vivo artery scans

authors: Wenhan Zheng; Zeyang Sun; Keer Huang; Li Lin; Zhenzhong Liu; Xiaoxiao Xu; Yunrui Cao; Qingjun Liu
